items.title: Senior US soldier arrested by UK counter-terror police
items.summary: The 41-year-old was arrested on suspicion of offences under the National Security Act which relate to Russia, police say.

items.title: David Walliams accused of sexual misconduct after losing injunction bid
items.summary: ITN and the Guardian allege the comedian preyed on teenage girls and young women. He has denied all allegations.

items.title: Watch: What we know about the allegations against Walliams
items.summary: The author and comedian recently lost a court battle trying to block publication of the allegations.

items.title: Inside devastated front-line city that Russia wants Ukraine to give up
items.summary: The BBC gains rare access to a specialist drone unit defending the eastern city of Slovyansk from heavy Russian fire.

items.title: Arrests made in Mohamed Al Fayed probe in France, police say
items.summary: The Ritz hotel in Paris, which is still owned by the Al Fayed family, is one of the properties searched by police.

items.title: Train attack driver's '10 seconds' to change line
items.summary: Andrew Johnson tells jurors he heard over the intercom "'there's a knifeman stabbing people'".

items.title: Watch: Meghan's first public appearance since father arrested
items.summary: Meghan arrived at the European Parliament in Brussels with her husband, Prince Harry, who delivered a speech about online child safety.

items.title: Sales of tinned food and bottled water jump after 'Be Ready' campaign launch
items.summary: Sales of essential goods such as hand sanitiser soar after the government called on households to be prepared for emergencies.
